text: JFE Steel Corporation sits in the JFE Group: JFE Holdings, Inc. is the group's wholly-owning parent company, formed in September 2002 by NKK and Kawasaki Steel by share transfer.
short: JFE Steel is under JFE Holdings, the JFE Group's wholly-owning parent.

source.name: JFE Holdings: About JFE Group
source.quote: September 2002, NKK and Kawasaki Steel jointly established JFE Holdings, a wholly owning parent company through share transfer.
source.note: No date on the page; opened 2026-10-03.
